commands.command: maintainer decision (ayaan, repository maintainer): both remaining revision 3 items are accepted as they are. - **default-on recovery: accepted.** recovery is on by default. without it, a stalled turn ends in a retry notice and the user has to repeat themselves. a recovery turn is an ordinary follow-up that runs under the queue's existing admission, abort and authority checks, so it has the same exposure as any queued follow-up. it doesn't replay the inbound message and runs over the persisted transcript. the model sees its own tool calls and results there and is told not to repeat actions that already ran, which limits repeated side effects. - **revalidate operator authority before the recovery's final channel send: declined, same as revision 2.** there's no extra send-time fence. queued follow-ups don't have one either, and the recovery turn's authority is checked at enqueue and at follow-up admission the same way theirs is. if the stalled turn's authority is already stale at the stall, nothing is continued and the existing notice is sent.
